ETU “LETI”: INTERNATIONAL STUDENT EXCHANGE PROGRAM 
FACT SHEET 
Contact information 
University Website https://etu.ru/en/university/   
Name of the Office Responsible for the 
Exchange Program 
International Academic Mobility Office 
Address of the Office ETU “LETI” International Academic Mobility 
Office 
Office Room 3309 
Prof. Popov Str. 5F, Saint-Petersburg, 197022, 
Russia 
Telephone +7 812 234-13-87 
Head of the Office Ms. Liudmila Podgornaya 
lnpodgornaya@etu.ru  
Inbound Exchange Coordinator Ms. Oxana Isaeva 
oiisaeva@etu.ru  
Outbound Exchange Coordinator Ms. Milena Kazaryan 
makazaryan@etu.ru 
 
Academic Year Information 
Fall Semester. Dates September 1 ~ December 18 
Fall Semester. Test period December  18 ~ December 28 
Fall Semester. Final Examinations January 4 ~ January 20 
Spring Semester. Dates February 1 ~ May 18 
Spring Semester. Test period May 18 ~ May 31 
Spring Semester. Final Examinations June 1 ~ June 20 
 
Academic Information 
Course list https://etu.ru/en/study/masters-degree/master-
s-degree-programs  
Official Academic Transcript Official academic Transcript will be issued and 
sent to an outbound exchange coordinator of 
partner institutions 
Grading System 5 – excellent 
4 – good 
3 – satisfactory 
2 – unsatisfactory

Application Information 
Maximum Period of Exchange 1 year (2 semesters) 
Eligibility Graduate students nominated by the 
international office of partner institutions 
CGPA Requirement Average of “4” or above out of “5”  
English Proficiency Requirement (for Non-
native English Speakers Only) 
IELTS Academic 6.0, TOEFL iBT 79 
(It may be substituted with equivalent proof 
documents approved by an exchange 
coordinator at home university) 
Nomination Period for Fall Semester April 1 
Application Period for Fall Semester April 15 
Nomination Period for Spring Semester November 1 
Application Period for Spring Semester November 15  
Nomination to ETU “LETI” Outbound exchange coordinators at partner 
universities will send a list of nominated 
students to the Inbound exchange coordinator 
(oiisaeva@etu.ru). Required data: 
name/surname, gender, DOB, major, e-mail 
Application Documents to Prepare  1. Academic Transcript in English 
2. Official Score of English Proficiency (for 
non-native English speakers only) 
3. CV 
4. Motivation Letter 
5. Copy of Passport 
How to submit the Application Documents All application documents (in PDF) should be 
sent to the Inbound exchange coordinator. 
Application Outcome Announcement Fall: by the end of May 
Spring: by the end of November 
 
Visa Requirements 
Student’s Visa Application Process Once students receive the invitation from ETU 
“LETI”, they are required to apply for their 
visas individually at the nearest Russian 
Embassy in their home country prior to 
entering Russia. 
 
Medical Insurance 
Medical Insurance Requirement All the foreign students, studying at ETU 
“LETI” must have a medical insurance 
certificate valid for Saint-Petersburg.  
 
The medical insurance can be acquired upon 
arrival in any Russian insurance company.  
The medical insurance should be valid until the 
date of the termination of registration in 
Russian Federation.

If you decide to acquire the insurance 
certificate at ETU “LETI”, the staff of 
International student’s office help with the 
necessary arrangements. If the insurance is 
being acquired in the other insurance company, 
the student should take care of all the 
necessary arrangements by himself. 
 
Housing 
University Dormitories  Dormitory is guaranteed for all incoming 
exchange students. 
Cost ~25$ per month 
Meals are excluded 
Housing fee must be paid within 2 weeks upon 
the arrival
